name: YodlRouter
fix_description: In transferFee, the function is public and accepts arbitrary from/to parameters. When from != address(this), it calls safeTransferFrom(token, from, to, fee) which transfers tokens from any address that has approved the router. Attacker calls transferFee with from=victim to steal their approved tokens. Fix: require(from == msg.sender || from == address(this)) to prevent transferring from arbitrary addresses.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward arbitrary token transfer / missing access control issue: the attacker directly calls transferFee with victim addresses as the from parameter and 100% feeBps to drain approved USDC. The PoC is very short, involves no complex DeFi primitives or multi-contract chaining, and a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
